rows.kind: refinement of his statement (stays as written unless it is our misreading)
rows.as_the_page_reads: 'Cas de dim 2. Sauf erreur, on trouve la description des complexes cellulaires combinatoires de dim <= 2'
rows.should_read: oriented maquettes of dim <= 2 are Serre graphs with 2-cells whose boundary is a vertex-disjoint union of directed cycles (loops and e e^-1 allowed); with an added axiom 'boundary connected' they are the 2-complexes whose cells are attached along closed edge paths through no vertex twice; the one-vertex torus is excluded; the regular CW complexes are the subclass without loops and without an edge used both ways
